narratives.Description: [framework-gap] BLOCKER Deposited .agents/hooks.json uses grouped SessionStart shape, causing agy 1.5.18 to reject the entire file and fail open on all PreToolUse hooks
narratives.Overview:
## Acceptance Criteria

- [ ] `agyDirectiveEntry()` emits `SessionStart` as a flat handler array (`[{ command, timeout }]`) and keeps `PreToolUse` grouped (`[{ matcher: "*", hooks: [{ command, timeout }] }]`).
- [ ] `hasAgyRegistration()` accepts the new deposited shape, and treats an earlier grouped-`SessionStart` deposit as drifted so repair rewrites it.
- [ ] `agyEntryCommands()`, `isManagedAgyHookEntry()` and `stripAgyHostHookConfig()` read both flat handler entries and grouped `{ hooks: [...] }` entries, so a flat `SessionStart` is recognised and stripped.
- [ ] A test fixture asserts the deposited `.agents/hooks.json` parses under the agy contract: `SessionStart` entries carry `command` directly, and `PreToolUse` entries carry `matcher` and `hooks`.
- [ ] The `verify:hooks-installed` success summary lists agy when it is deposited.

issueCommentThread.body:
Rewriting the body to criteria-only for ingest (Scott asked to take the new agy benchmark issue through merge for 0.132.1; no arc: the fix and files are named). Runs as its own story in parallel with #7438. Prior body quoted below for the audit trail.

<details><summary>Prior body</summary>

## Summary

Deposited .agents/hooks.json uses grouped SessionStart shape, causing agy 1.5.18 to reject the entire file and fail open on all PreToolUse hooks

## Context

Internal benchmark evidence (private): verified Directive 0.132.0 (maintainer dist-tag) deposited .agents/hooks.json in a fresh Antigravity (agy 1.5.18, win32) session and isolated agy CLI print-mode runs.

## Expected behavior

Antigravity (agy) loads .agents/hooks.json cleanly, injects the Directive SessionStart systemMessage, and executes zzzz-directive PreToolUse hooks on every tool call. Per Antigravity hooks.json contract, SessionStart is a flat array of handler objects ([{ command, timeout }]), whereas only PreToolUse/PostToolUse use grouped { matcher, hooks: [...] } entries.

## Actual behavior / gap

agyDirectiveEntry() in packages/core/src/init-deposit/agent-hooks.ts deposits SessionStart with a grouped wrapper ([{ hooks: [{ command, timeout }] }]). On agy 1.5.18, parsing .agents/hooks.json fails with: Failed to parse hooks file .../.agents/hooks.json: invalid hook zzzz-directive: command hook must specify 'command' (hooks.go:318). Because file parsing fails, agy loads zero hooks from the file: neither SessionStart nor PreToolUse fires, so Directive PreToolUse enforcement fails completely open in live agy sessions. Switching SessionStart to the flat array ([{ command, timeout }]) in an isolated agy 1.5.18 test immediately resolves the parse error and causes both SessionStart (systemMessage injected) and PreToolUse (run_command intercepted) to fire.

## Session notes

Root cause touches at least two core helpers: (1) packages/core/src/init-deposit/agent-hooks.ts agyDirectiveEntry() must emit flat SessionStart handlers ([{ command, timeout }]) while keeping grouped PreToolUse ([{ matcher: '*', hooks: [{ command, timeout }] }]), and hasAgyRegistration() compares against agyDirectiveEntry(); (2) packages/core/src/init-deposit/host-hook-outer.ts agyEntryCommands() currently only reads group.hooks and ignores flat handler objects, so flat SessionStart entries would be missed by isManagedAgyHookEntry() / stripAgyHostHookConfig() unless updated to handle both flat handler entries and grouped { hooks: [...] } entries. Minor related note: verify:hooks-installed success summary still lists only Claude, Grok, Cursor, Codex without agy.

## Adoption impact

This report is a consumer hard-stop: the consumer cannot complete an intended Directive flow and has no reasonable workaround.

Title token: `BLOCKER`. This token does not apply the `adoption-blocker` ranking label. A privileged actor applies that label after the body-evidence test.

### Affected consumer flow and version

Antigravity (agy 1.5.18) first-class host hooks on Directive 0.132.0

### Documented alternatives attempted

No consumer workaround exists: leaving .agents/hooks.json as deposited fails open completely in agy; hand-editing SessionStart to flat format fails hasAgyRegistration() exact-JSON equality and breaks verify:hooks-installed and the gated session ritual.

### Observed recovery cost

Full loss of live Directive PreToolUse and SessionStart enforcement on agy until fixed in a patch release (e.g. 0.132.1).

### Triage owner and date

_(to be filled by a privileged actor when applying `adoption-blocker`)_
